Background: a room whose floor and ceiling are both perfect mirrors, with plain dark walls, so that she and her reflected twin face each other and the stack of reflections repeats endlessly upward and downward, her legs doubling into the floor mirror, a ring of soft warm bulbs around the ceiling edge repeating in the reflections, the whole floor clearly visible and in focus, lit by soft warm light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, the reflections being part of that same photograph, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
